auditor.model_family_disclosure: Same model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), different session and agent role; not an independent model.

scope: Voice UI strings added on feat/qwen-voice-ui-2026-11-17 at translations commit bad1701b2d: ui.chat.voice (81 keys), ui.settings.voice (2 keys), ui.settings.speech.provider (12 keys), ui.providers.stored_key (5 keys)

findings.problem: Section name unquoted («в провайдерах») while the same section is quoted in provider.none_ready («Провайдерах») and in the existing ui.settings.model.provider_callout.providers_link («Провайдеры»).

findings.en: Stopped at {time} — you spoke over it
findings.problem: «вы заговорили поверх» is a calque with no object.

findings.en: Lets you talk to a conversation hands-free. Off by default. While it is off, nothing for voice runs: no microphone, no speech models and no background checks. Turning it on adds a voice button to the composer; turning it off stops voice at once and releases the microphone.
findings.current: Позволяет говорить с разговором, не касаясь экрана. По умолчанию выключено. Пока голос выключен, для него ничего не работает: ни микрофон, ни речевые модели, ни фоновые проверки. После включения в поле ввода появляется кнопка голоса; при выключении голос останавливается сразу, а микрофон освобождается.
findings.problem: «Позволяет говорить с разговором, не касаясь экрана» renders 'hands-free' as 'without touching the screen' (a different claim) and repeats говорить/разговор awkwardly.
findings.suggested: Позволяет вести разговор голосом, без рук. ... (rest unchanged)

findings.problem: «из вашего баланса Radient» changes 'Radient credit' to 'balance'; the rest of the ru UI says «кредиты Radient» (ui.common.errors, ui.common.account).
findings.suggested: Оплачивается за счёт ваших кредитов Radient.

findings.problem: Same unquoted «в провайдерах» as chat.voice.set_up_provider; none_ready quotes it.

findings.en: Uses your own ElevenLabs account, which ElevenLabs bills.
findings.current: Используется ваш аккаунт ElevenLabs, и счёт выставляет ElevenLabs.
findings.problem: Drops 'own' («ваш аккаунт»); en says 'your own ElevenLabs account'.
findings.suggested: Используется ваш собственный аккаунт ElevenLabs, счёт выставляет ElevenLabs.

checks: English, context and target SHA-256 recomputed from the bytes on disk at the worktree HEAD named in scope; each namespace block names exactly those bytes.

ICU parity: every message of the 4 namespaces (100 keys) parsed with the project's own @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (v3.5.21) and compared with English: same argument names/types ({title}, {reason}, {time}, {count}); key sets and key order equal English's; 700/700 (7 locales x 100 keys) clean. NFC on every message; no bidi control characters; no leading/trailing or doubled whitespace; no message identical to English; brand names (Radient, ElevenLabs, macOS, Local Operator), the 30-second figure, the ↑ arrow and ' · ' separators preserved wherever English has them; final-stop and ellipsis shape matches English (two ur/hi empty_history differences are the SOV verb after the closing quote, accepted).

Every string read against its English value and en .context.json sidecar (role, tone, note), against this locale's style guide and the core glossary (hashes in references), and against the sibling already-audited backend wording local_operator/i18n/catalogues/<locale>/wire.voice.json for provider/approval/conversation/key terms.

Neighbour consistency measured against existing UI catalogues of this locale: Retry, Settings, Providers (ui.settings.model.provider_callout.providers_link) / Provider, Reconnect, Pause, Approve/Deny (ui.chat.approval.option.*), Remove/Delete, Ready, Dictation, Speak aloud, API key, Radient credit, composer wording (ui.agents.config.banner.unavailable).
Register: es tú, fr vous, ru вы, vi bạn, zh 你, hi आप, ur آپ — consistent per style guide; no please-particles except where the zh style guide's 请 rule applies (checked per directive).
Length fit judged from character counts and from voice-composer.tsx layout (chips shrink-0, captions truncate); no rendered frame was produced or reviewed in this audit.

Back-translations of the 12 most consequential strings (approval, pending-card, voice-not-enabled, stream-lost, voice-elsewhere, provider-unset, rate limit, Radient/ElevenLabs billing, none-ready, key removal) recorded in back_translations for the namespaces this receipt covers.
